notes: Software capability demonstration using realistic fictitious geometry, supplier forces, duty and criteria. Not a site-specific design. Scope: five simply supported 25-ft bays of a 5-ton capped runway (W24X104 + C15X50) in an existing building with W14X90 columns, new built-up tapered I haunches field welded to the columns, bolted end bearings, girder-mounted end stops and cap tieback angles bolted to the channel cap.

fabrication.steel: W girder ASTM A992; cap channel and connection plates ASTM A572 Grade 50. Fictitious rail specification per R-6 schedule.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, sizes as detailed (tie bolts smaller than the other girder bolts), pretensioned to the RCSC Table 8.1 minimum pretension. Standard holes and Class B faying surfaces. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts are pretensioned against steel sleeves. Rail joint bolts snug-tight in sliding slots.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen welds. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts/stops and remove temporary welded attachments by grinding. Cap: continuous fillet each W top-flange edge, size and end development per the cap section and development details. Full cap bearing contact required. Bearing stiffeners CJP to W top flange, bottom fitted.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds and bolt installations; verify pretension and faying-surface preparation. MT at attachment terminations and repaired welds. Record baseline rail and connection condition before commissioning.
fabrication.erection: Provide temporary lateral/torsional restraint until both flange ties are complete. Set bearing plates level, fit bearing stiffeners, and verify end rotation clearance. Do not operate the crane before alignment and supplier commissioning checks.
fabrication.railAlignment: Survey both rails unloaded and during commissioning. Record gauge, elevation and straightness at supports and midspan; use the stated demonstration tolerances, subject to the actual crane supplier requirements.
